{"contract":"Any public booking surface rendered for a member of an organisation must derive its visual identity — brandColor, darkBrandColor and the light/dark theme preference — from that member's organisation when one exists, falling back to the individual's own settings only for users outside an organisation; every layer on that path (the Prisma select that fetches the branding fields, the server-side props builder that shapes the public `profile`, and the client hook that writes the CSS variables) must carry the organisation's values, so that a personal link and a team link under the same organisation render identically.","defect_location":{"repo":"calcom/cal.com","summary":"packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:585-614 builds the public profile with `const styleProfile = team || event.parent?.team || nonTeamProfile;` and then reads `styleProfile.brandColor` / `darkBrandColor` / `theme` (lines 606-608). For a team event `styleProfile` is the team (or, for managed events, the parent org team), so team pages inherit organisation styling; for a personal event it falls through to `nonTeamProfile` — the user record — so the organisation's colours and theme are never consulted. The same file's select at packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:31-50 makes this unfixable in place: the owner's `organization` relation is selected with only `id, name, slug, bannerUrl`, i.e. the org's `brandColor`, `darkBrandColor` and `theme` are not even fetched. The personal profile page repeats the defect independently at apps/web/server/lib/[user]/getServerSideProps.ts:133-145, where `profile` is assembled as `theme: user.theme, brandColor: user.brandColor ?? DEFAULT_LIGHT_BRAND_COLOR, darkBrandColor: user.darkBrandColor ?? DEFAULT_DARK_BRAND_COLOR` while `organization: user.profile.organization` is carried alongside but never used for styling; that props object is consumed by apps/web/modules/users/views/users-public-view.tsx:29 (`useTheme(profile.theme)`). The user rows come from getUsersInOrgContext (apps/web/server/lib/[user]/getServerSideProps.ts:201-220) -> UserRepository.findUsersByUsername (packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:169-179) whose `userSelect` (packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:82-122) and packages/prisma/selects/user.ts:37-53 select only the user's own `theme`/`brandColor`/`darkBrandColor`. The personal event-type page passes the same profile straight through (apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:263-282), and the rendering end — packages/features/bookings/Booker/utils/use-brand-colors.tsx:5-19 -> packages/lib/getBrandColours.tsx -> packages/ui/styles/useCalcomTheme.tsx — faithfully paints whatever colours it is handed, so the divergence is entirely in the resolution layers.
